
```jsx
import { CxFormRange } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxFormRange from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/form/CxFormRange'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **disabled** | Toggle the disabled state for the component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **max** | Specifies the maximum value for the component. | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
| **min** | Specifies the minimum value for the component. | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onChange** | Method called immediately after the `value` prop changes. | `ChangeEventHandler<HTMLInputElement>` \| `undefined` | - |
| **readOnly** | Toggle the readonly state for the component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **steps** | Specifies the interval between legal numbers in the component. | `number` | - |
| **value** | The `value` attribute of component.<br/>@controllable onChange | `string` \| `number` \| `string[]` \| `undefined` | - |
